p2_b0.ocr: The Drydocking and maintenance schedule for Yang Ming Marine from 2019 to 2024 reflects a systematic increase in maintenance costs and an improvement in uptime ratio, critical for operational efficiency in the shipping and maritime sector. In 2019, the maintenance costs were $5M, with an uptime ratio of 92%, and a drydock frequency of 1.0. The following year, 2020, saw an increase in maintenance costs to $6M and an uptime ratio rise to 93%, with a drydock frequency of 1.2.

p2_b1.ocr: In 2021, maintenance costs escalated to $7M, maintaining the upward trend with a continued increase in uptime ratio to 94% and a drydock frequency of 1.3. The year 2022 recorded maintenance costs of $8M, further improvement in uptime ratio to 95%, and a drydock frequency of 1.4. In 2023, the maintenance costs reached $9M, with a corresponding uptime ratio of 96% and a drydock frequency of 1.5.
